description: Presidential Secretariat - Establishing a Presidential Task Force for development Priorities and Self-employment and to meet  Smallish economic Livelihood needs of those engaged in Traditional vocation etc.
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (18 appointed members including their full names and titles) AND detailed descriptions of their responsibilities and the task force's mandate (studying exploitation of geological resources, identifying development priorities, assessing supply quantities, remarking areas for resource extraction, identifying scientific methodologies, obtaining views from stakeholders). The content includes both "who" (government personnel) and "what" (detailed portfolio responsibilities and tasks), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
